# ADR 0005: Platform scheduler on scale-to-zero platforms

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** FX reference rates service

## Context

@Scheduled doesn't fire while Cloud Run / Container Apps instances are scaled to zero.

## Decision

Keep @Scheduled for VPS and always-on containers (configurable); use EventBridge Scheduler, Cloud Scheduler or Container Apps jobs to call the admin endpoint elsewhere.

## Consequences

Works on every target; one more piece of cloud configuration.

## Alternatives considered

Min instances = 1 everywhere (costs more).
